description: This file is a PHP source file that manages the Wi-Fi network configuration interface for a web-based router or gateway device. It includes code for displaying current Wi-Fi settings, handling user interactions to modify those settings via forms and AJAX requests, and includes embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior. It references various internal configuration parameters such as radio modes, channels, security modes, WPS, band steering, and multiple SSID configurations, indicating its role as a central part of the Wi-Fi management web UI.

methods.name: update_Wi_Fi_control_list
methods.description: Updates the Wi-Fi control list via AJAX request and updates the security filtering UI elements.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration data via AJAX to update wireless settings.

methods.name: show_extch
methods.description: Shows or hides certain extension channel options based on the selected channel.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates device name and MAC address inputs before adding to the control list.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Reindexes and stripes rows in a table for visual clarity.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new MAC filtering or auto-learned device row to the respective table.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Removes a specified row from the filtering table after user confirmation.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies an auto-learned device to the manual filter list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves the MAC filtering configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves the wireless configuration parameters via AJAX.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables radio and WPS features, sending corresponding AJAX requests.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates a WPS pairing process with a client device via AJAX.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels WPS pairing process via AJAX.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with band steering history information.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Fetches and displays band steering history via AJAX.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering configuration parameters via AJAX.
